engine: gapsystudio's 'Pull Me' drawer — an edge-anchored PANEL sits mostly off-screen with a small GRAB-TAB ('Pull Me') on its visible edge. You DRAG the tab to pull the panel out (it follows the pointer 0..width); release past a threshold and it SNAPS open, otherwise snaps back closed. Click the tab to toggle; Enter/Space too. The tab LABEL + chevron flip with the open state. Harvested from D_gapsy (C /about — the 'Pull Me' tab on the far-left edge).

measured_teardown.move: progress p 0..1 = how far the panel is pulled out (0 closed = panel pushed off its edge by its full width except the tab; 1 open = panel fully in). While dragging the tab, panel translateX follows the pointer delta (dragging toward centre opens), clamped 0..width, no transition. On release: a flick (|dx|>60px) opens/closes by direction; otherwise snap to 0 or 1 by whether p>=threshold, with a cubic-bezier transition. A tap (no move) toggles. Pointer move/up tracked on WINDOW so a drag leaving the tab still ends cleanly (F-08 lesson). The tab rides the panel's inner edge (left:100% / right:100%).
measured_teardown.cited: gapsy /about: a dark rounded 'Pull Me' tab pinned half-off the far-left edge; it's a draggable handle that pulls out a hidden panel/drawer from the edge (a tactile UI cue).

side.what: which edge the panel anchors to: 'left' or 'right'. Sets the closed-direction and the tab's edge + chevron.

threshold.what: release past this fraction of the panel width => snap open, else snap closed (a slow drag). A fast flick overrides by direction.

ease.what: the snap curve — a soft settle.

entry: DragTabReveal.create(target, opts) -> { open(), close(), toggle(), set(p,animate), isOpen(), destroy }. target = .dtr-stage > .dtr-panel(.dtr-tab(.dtr-tab-label) + .dtr-content). The panel width = CSS --dtr-w. set(p 0..1) is a PURE position (p 0 closed, 1 open); open/close/toggle animate + flip the label.
law: transform: translateX (panel) + opacity only; JS sets the inline transform + toggles .is-open + swaps the label; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; NO WebGL; Pointer Events (touch ok); reduced-motion -> instant snap (no transition). owns_pin false, owns_scroll false. Pointer move/up/cancel on WINDOW (a drag that leaves the tab still ends + settles) — the F-08 drag law.
gate_mode: triggered (drag / click / keyboard), NOT scroll. Verify: closed = panel off its edge (tx = -width for left); big drag toward centre past threshold => snap open (tx 0) + label flips; click toggles; small drag (<threshold) snaps back; a drag released OFF the tab / off-window still settles. Smoothness via the TRIGGERED variant (arm the meter, cycle drag+click).
proven: lab: a left 'Pull Me' contact drawer over OUR QUADRO aerial render. Measured live: start closed tx=-380 label 'Pull Me'; big drag right -> open tx=0 label 'Close'; click -> closed tx=-380 label 'Pull Me'; small drag (25px) -> still closed; drag released far off-window (y=20) -> still open, settled (F-08 holds). Mid-drag (p=0.5): the dark panel half-pulled with the tab on its edge over the QUADRO page; open: full contact panel (email/phone/socials/presentation) + tab label 'Close ‹' chevron flipped (matches gapsy /about). Triggered probe (4x CPU throttle, 5 drag+click cycles): 1/256 long frames (0.4%), 59.9fps -> PASS. Zero console errors.
